title: Jethro Visits Moses in the Wilderness
description: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law and priest of Midian, travels to meet Moses in the wilderness at the mountain of God. He brings with him Moses' wife Zipporah and their two sons, Gershom and Eliezer. Moses tells him everything the Lord has done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians, and Jethro praises the Lord, acknowledging that He is greater than all gods. Jethro offers burnt offerings and sacrifices, and Aaron and the elders of Israel come to eat with him in God's presence.
